share_notes.name: notes
share_notes.said:
You lend notes (port 65283) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 65283 --limit <number>`.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare notes` stops lending it.

Leave this running; Ctrl-C stops it.
